explication: OpenProject is a self-hosted project-management and team-collaboration platform. A representative workflow is a user configuring work-package query parameters, which the backend parses and applies to a query; the query layer then supplies results for API representation. The tree and README also identify project/portfolio, agile, scheduling, time/cost, collaboration, and integration capabilities. The sampled sources establish query transformations, Gantt query generation, and selected frontend interactions, but do not show the full request-to-result orchestration or most feature implementations.
